FindItemsAnswer.yaml:
FindItemsAnswer:
    title: Answer
    description: >-
      The page's items in reading order, the headings over several items, the running head.
    annotations:
      asking: find_items
    attributes:
      items:
        multivalued: true
        range: FindItemsAnswerItem
        inlined: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        title: Items
        description: >-
          The items field in the Answer response.
        annotations:
          description_in_wire: false
      headings:
        multivalued: true
        range: FindItemsAnswerHeading
        inlined: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        title: Headings
        annotations:
          default_empty_list: true
          description_in_wire: false
        description: >-
          The headings field in the Answer response.
      running_head:
        multivalued: true
        range: integer
        required: true
        title: Running Head
        annotations:
          default_empty_list: true
          description_in_wire: false
        description: >-
          The running_head field in the Answer response.
